text_simplified: The text discusses the role of the masjid in Islamic tarbiyah (upbringing), based on the seerah of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. It clarifies that the masjid was not merely a place of worship but a comprehensive educational and tarbiyah institution. It also shows that the Prophet ﷺ dedicated time to teaching both women and men and addressed incorrect behaviors. The aim is to guide parents on the importance of the masjid in raising children.

review_defects.why: Arabic 'يعالج' means he used to treat/correct, implying active remediation; English 'addressed' is weaker and could mean merely mentioned or dealt with superficially.
Arabic 'الأهل' means family/household, not exclusively parents; English narrows to parents, potentially excluding other caregivers or relatives involved in upbringing.
Arabic 'كان يخصص' indicates a habitual/ongoing practice; English 'dedicated' is simple past, losing the habitual aspect.
